FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #3 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'And you?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je m'appelle Amina.
   B. Et toi ?
   C. Comment tu t'appelles ?
   D. Ça s'écrit comment ?

2. How do you say 'no' in French? (1 mark)
   A. non
   B. bonjour
   C. Enchanté
   D. bonsoir

3. How do you say 'goodbye' in French? (1 mark)
   A. au revoir
   B. bonjour
   C. bien
   D. Enchanté

4. How do you say 'Who is it?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Qui est-ce ?
   B. la famille
   C. l'enfant
   D. Voici

5. How do you say 'It is, this is' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la grand-mère
   B. le père
   C. C'est
   D. la fille

6. How do you say 'in front of' in French? (1 mark)
   A. dans
   B. devant
   C. derrière
   D. sur

7. Fill in: Dans la cuisine, il y a un ______. (1 mark)
   A. tapis
   B. lit
   C. frigo
   D. canapé

8. How do you say 'under' in French? (1 mark)
   A. entre
   B. devant
   C. sur
   D. sous

9. How do you say 'Friday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. vendredi
   B. lundi
   C. mercredi
   D. samedi

10. How do you say 'tomorrow' in French? (1 mark)
   A. demain
   B. je joue
   C. je danse
   D. aujourd'hui

11. How do you write the number 2 in French? (1 mark)
   A. vingt-cinq
   B. deux
   C. neuf
   D. onze

12. How do you write the number 19 in French? (1 mark)
   A. deux
   B. trente et un
   C. dix-neuf
   D. vingt

13. How do you say 'milk' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le lait
   B. le jus
   C. les bonbons
   D. le gâteau

14. Fill in: Le matin, je mange ______ pain. (1 mark)
   A. de la
   B. des
   C. un
   D. du

15. How do you say 'the stomach' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la jambe
   B. le pied
   C. l'épaule
   D. le ventre

16. How do you say 'tall, big' in French? (1 mark)
   A. grand
   B. court
   C. long
   D. noir

17. How do you say 'the cloud' in French? (1 mark)
   A. une inondation
   B. le vent
   C. le nuage
   D. l'orage

18. How do you say 'pleasant' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a du vent.
   B. Il fait froid.
   C. Il pleut.
   D. agréable

19. Fill in: Mets le tapis ______ le canapé. (in front of) (1 mark)
   A. sous
   B. devant
   C. sur
   D. derrière

20. How do you say 'the rug' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le magasin
   B. le tapis
   C. le jardin
   D. la clé

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into French: 'On Thursday, I sing.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. Translate into French: 'I have two feet.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

23. Translate into French: 'When is your birthday?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

24. Translate into French: 'It is windy.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. Translate into French: 'He has short hair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

26. Translate into French: 'The cat is under the chair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

27. Translate into French: 'On Saturday, I play.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

28. Translate into French: 'It is a bed.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

29. Translate into French: 'The cat is behind the door.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

30. Write yesterday, today and tomorrow in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

31. Translate into French: 'And you?' (2 marks) (2 marks)

FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #3 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Et toi ?
   And you? in French is Et toi ?.

2. A — non
   no in French is non.

3. A — au revoir
   goodbye in French is au revoir.

4. A — Qui est-ce ?
   Who is it? in French is Qui est-ce ?.

5. C — C'est
   It is, this is in French is C'est.

6. B — devant
   in front of in French is devant.

7. C — frigo
   A fridge belongs in the kitchen.

8. D — sous
   under in French is sous.

9. A — vendredi
   Friday in French is vendredi.

10. A — demain
   tomorrow in French is demain.

11. B — deux
   2 in French is deux.

12. C — dix-neuf
   19 in French is dix-neuf.

13. A — le lait
   milk in French is le lait.

14. D — du
   Du is used before masculine foods you do not count, like du pain.

15. D — le ventre
   the stomach in French is le ventre.

16. A — grand
   tall, big in French is grand.

17. C — le nuage
   the cloud in French is le nuage.

18. D — agréable
   pleasant in French is agréable.

19. B — devant
   Devant means in front of.

20. B — le tapis
   the rug in French is le tapis.
